name: euro-bot
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 8 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  euro:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
      - name: deps
        run: pip install requests
      - name: run
        env:
          TG_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TG_BOT_TOKEN }}
          TG_CHAT_ID: ${{ secrets.TG_CHAT_ID }}
          TG_EURO_CHAT: ${{ secrets.TG_EURO_CHAT }}
        run: python euro_bot.py
      - name: save db
        run: |
          git config user.name "euro-bot"
          git config user.email "bot@local"
          git add -f euro.db
          git diff --cached --quiet || { git commit -m "euro tracking update"; git push; }
